name: @screentime/desktop
description: Screentime dashboard: an Electrobun app (Bun main process + Svelte UI in WebKitGTK)

scripts.dev: bun run build:view && electrobun prepare && electrobun dev --watch
scripts.start: bun run build:view && electrobun prepare && electrobun dev
scripts.build: bun run build:view && electrobun prepare && electrobun build --env=stable
